# Passive Vent A passive vent connects a [textlink="pipe network" link="PipeNetworks"] to the surrounding atmosphere without using a pump.
It requires no [textlink="power" link="Power"] and simply allows gas to flow naturally between the pipe and the atmosphere according to the pressure difference.
Passive vents are useful for gas storage, combustion chambers, and other systems that require free gas exchange without active control.
